objects.name: Accounts
objects.description: District-level account-code master (~111K rows). FK to `District` and `School`; referenced by `BudgetAccounts.AccountId` and `UserAccounts.AccountId`. The district-side identity that a `BudgetAccounts` row maps to before a user is granted access via `UserAccounts`.

objects.name: allitems
objects.description: Denormalized flat snapshot joining `BidHeaders` × `Items` × `CrossRefs` × `Catalog` × `PricePlans` × `Category` (~6.3M rows). Reporting / working table — pricing, descriptions, vendor item codes, and order-vs-bid totals collapsed into one wide row. Rebuilt by batch jobs; not a system of record.

objects.name: Approvals
objects.description: Per-step approval audit trail (~8M rows). Records who approved or rejected each requisition at each level of the district's approval chain, with timestamp and any comment. Combined with `PendingApprovals` to drive the queue an approver sees in the UI.

objects.name: ApprovalsHistory
objects.description: Historical / superseded approval rows (~342K rows). Same shape as `Approvals`; rows accumulate here when a requisition's approval chain is restarted (e.g. amount changed past a threshold) so the prior chain is preserved separately from the active one.

objects.name: Audit
objects.description: Generic audit log (~2.6M rows) — application-level events (logins, permission changes, data exports, admin actions). Distinct from the change-log tables, which are field-level.

objects.name: Awardings
objects.description: Bid-award run header (~11K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `StartTimestamp`) recording when an award computation ran, when it ended, how many notifications were created, and when they were sent. Operational header — the actual award rows land in `Awards`.

objects.name: Awards
objects.description: Bid award outcomes (~139K rows). Records which vendor's `BidResults` were chosen for each awarded line, including award date and award type. Awarded prices typically flow back into `CrossRefs` via a vendor catalog upload.

objects.name: AwardsCatalogList
objects.description: Junction `Awards` ↔ `Catalog` (~85K rows). Mirrors `BidsCatalogList` post-award — which catalogs the award covers and the awarded `DiscountRate` per catalog. The downstream effect of these rows is what flows into `CrossRefs` pricing.

objects.name: BatchBook
objects.description: Staging for batch requisition / budget-account loads (~218K rows). One row per inbound record from a district batch file with the parsed `DistrictCode`, `CometCode`, `AccountCode` resolved to surrogate IDs (`DistrictId`, `BudgetAccountId`, `UserAccountId`), input vs. calculated amounts, duplicate / amount validation flags, and the resulting `RequisitionId`. Working set for the batch import pipeline.

objects.name: BatchDetail
objects.description: Staging table for batch-imported requisition / order detail (~5M rows). Holds raw character-typed values (`OrigType`, `OrigDistrictCode`, `OrigCometCode`, `OrigItemCode`, `OrigQuantity`) alongside their resolved IDs so the importer can report and back-out errors. `ErrorField` flags malformed rows.

objects.name: BatchDetailInserts
objects.description: Audit of line-inserts produced by batch loads (~1.2K rows). One row per (`RequisitionId`, `BatchDetailId`, `ItemId`, `qty`, `SourceId`) showing what each `BatchDetail` row produced when expanded into requisition lines. Sequential-GUID PK.

objects.name: Batches
objects.description: Batch-import job header (~14.5K rows). Parent of `BatchBook` rows — captures `BatchDate`, `Type`, `SourceId`, lifecycle timestamps (`Scheduled`, `Started`, `Loaded`, `Imported`, `Converted`, `Completed`), input / imported record counts, total `Amount`, and `ErrorCount`. One row per file ingestion attempt.

objects.name: BidAnswers
objects.description: Vendor responses to non-pricing bid questions (~552K rows) — terms, certifications, attribute confirmations.

objects.name: BidAnswersJournal
objects.description: Append-only change history for `BidAnswers` (~1.3M rows). Captures the prior value, session, and modification timestamp every time a vendor edits a non-pricing bid response.

objects.name: BidderCheckList
objects.description: Master list of bidder-checklist items (~140 rows). Per-checklist item: `CheckListText`, optional rich-text help, document-name / type, and flags for `OptionalDocument`, `OnFileEligible`, `UploadEligible`, `ExpirationDateReqd`, `DocNumberReqd`, `DocNumberLabel`. `BidHeaderCheckList` is the per-bid junction.

objects.name: BidderCheckListPkgDetail
objects.description: Junction `BidderCheckListPkgHeader` × `BidderCheckList` (~1.2K rows) with `DisplaySequence`. Defines which checklist items live in which package; packages are the reusable building block bound onto a `BidHeader`.

objects.name: BidderCheckListPkgHeader
objects.description: Bidder-checklist packages (~56 rows). Tiny header table — named, active-flagged groupings of checklist items. Detail rows in `BidderCheckListPkgDetail`.

objects.name: BidDocument
objects.description: Bid solicitation document templates (~11K rows). One row per reusable document (`DocumentTitle`, `DocumentType`, body text). `BidHeaderDocument` joins these to specific `BidHeaders` for a packet.

objects.name: BidDocumentTypes
objects.description: Bid document type lookup (~298 rows). Per `BidType` and optional `State`, defines the document categories used in bid packets (`Name`, `Description`, `Sequence`, `Grouping`) along with flags for vendor-specific, vendor-unique, expiration tracking, district visibility, and one-of-many display.

objects.name: BidHeaderCheckList
objects.description: Junction `BidHeaders` ↔ `BidderCheckList` items (~112K rows). Defines the checklist of items vendors must acknowledge to submit a response to a bid, with `DisplaySequence`.

objects.name: BidHeaderDetail
objects.description: Per-line bid specifications (~123M rows — second-largest table in EDS). Holds the items, specs, and quantities a bid is asking vendors to price. Always filter by `BidHeaderId` before any analytical work.

columns.name: BidHeaderDetailId
columns.description: Surrogate bigint PK — sequential GUID-backed. Prefer filtering by `BidHeaderId` rather than scanning this key; the table has 123M+ rows.

columns.name: BidHeaderId
columns.description: FK to `BidHeaders`. The primary filter column — always include a `WHERE BidHeaderId = ?` predicate before any other work on this table.

columns.name: DetailId
columns.description: FK to `Detail`. Links a bid-spec row to the requisition line item that originated it. NULL when the spec was added administratively rather than from a requisition.

columns.name: BidRequestItemId
columns.description: FK to `BidRequestItems` — the catalog item / spec the vendor is being asked to price. Join here to get item description and unit.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Estimated quantity the cooperative is committing to purchase. Used by vendors when pricing their bids.

columns.name: BidHeaderKey
columns.description: Denormalized copy of `BidHeaders.BidHeaderKey` (the clustered key). Included to support cluster-aligned range scans without an extra join.

columns.name: RequisitionId
columns.description: FK to `Requisitions` — the originating requisition when this spec row was system-generated. Matches `Detail.RequisitionId` for the same line.

objects.name: BidHeaderDocument
objects.description: Junction `BidHeaders` ↔ `BidDocuments` (~164K rows) defining which documents are attached to a bid solicitation, with `DisplaySequence` controlling order in the bid packet. Distinct from `DMSBidDocuments` which holds vendor-uploaded response attachments.

objects.name: BidHeaders
objects.description: Bid solicitation header (~9.6K rows). One row per RFP/IFB/cooperative bid issued to vendors. Drives the bid-response window and ultimately produces `Awards`.

objects.name: BidImportCatalogList
objects.description: Junction `BidImports` ↔ `Catalog` (~33K rows). Per-catalog discount terms a vendor has offered as part of a bid response. Resolves into `BidsCatalogList` once the response is accepted, and into `AwardsCatalogList` after award.

objects.name: BidImportCounties
objects.description: Junction `BidImports` ↔ `BidTradeCounties` (~65K rows). Lists which trade-counties a vendor's bid response covers, with `Active` and free-text `Comments`. Trades-bid scoping data.

objects.name: BidImports
objects.description: Vendor bid-response import header (~56K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `VendorId`) captured from a vendor's submitted bid file, with `BidItemDiscountRate`, `CatalogDiscountRate`, `MinimumOrder`, free-delivery / free-handling terms, and `Status`. Pairs with `Bids` (response header) and `BidResults` (line items).

objects.name: BidItems
objects.description: Master list of items eligible to appear on bids (~27.5M rows). Distinct from `BidRequestItems` (request-time snapshot) — this is the catalog side.

objects.name: BidManufacturers
objects.description: Bid-level manufacturer participation (~253K rows). One row per (`BidId`, `ManufacturerId`) with the negotiated `DiscountRate`. Aliased `BMA` elsewhere — referenced by `BidProductLines.BMAId`.

objects.name: BidMappedItems
objects.description: Audit of item remapping decisions made during bid setup. Records the original `OrigItemId`, the chosen `NewItemId`, a `ReasonCode`, and the date — so award lineage stays explicit when a bid line is re-pointed at a different master item.

objects.name: BidMgrTagFile
objects.description: Bid-manager tagging working set (~4.4M rows). Per-user (`Usr`) tag overlay against a target table (`Tbl`) and row pointer (`Ptr`) with current and original tag values. Used by the bid-management UI to track in-progress tag changes before persistence.

objects.name: BidMSRPResultPrices
objects.description: Per-tier MSRP-discount results submitted by a vendor on an MSRP-style bid (~423K rows). One row per `BidRequestPriceRange` per vendor result, with the discount-applied price.

objects.name: BidMSRPResults
objects.description: Vendor MSRP bid-response header (~41K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `BidImportId`, `ManufacturerId`) capturing the vendor's offered `DiscountRate`, write-in flags, supporting-document indicators (`AuthorizationLetter`, `SubmittedExcel`, `ProductCatalog`), and `WinningBidOverride`. Per-product-line detail is in `BidMSRPResultsProductLines`.

objects.name: BidMSRPResultsProductLines
objects.description: Per-product-line MSRP bid response (~110K rows). Lines under `BidMSRPResults` with the vendor's per-line `WeightedDiscount`, `MSRPOptionId`, and write-in product-line text. Resolves the actual rate applied for each product line in a vendor's MSRP response.

objects.name: BidPackageDocument
objects.description: Junction `BidPackage` ↔ `BidDocument` (~1.5K rows). Defines which documents are bundled into a reusable bid package (template), with `DisplaySequence`. `BidPackage` then attaches in bulk to `BidHeaders`.

objects.name: BidProductLinePrices
objects.description: Manufacturer product-line discount tiers offered by a vendor on a bid (~1.3M rows). `RangeBase` is the dollar floor for the tier; `DiscountRate` is the percent off list. Joins a `BidProductLines` row to its tiered pricing structure.

objects.name: BidProductLines
objects.description: Finer-grained discounts under a `BidManufacturers` row (~288K rows). Per-product-line (and per-`MSRPOptionId`) discount rate within the manufacturer's bid participation. Resolves the actual rate to apply when an item maps to a specific product line.

objects.name: BidQuestions
objects.description: Bid question/answer template (~24K rows). One row per question on a `BidTrade`, with display geometry (X/Y/Width/Height for both question and answer fields), text, expected `QuestionQty` / `QuestionUOMId`, and `AnswerTypeId` / `AnswerTypeMask`. Drives the bid form vendors fill out; responses land in `BidAnswers`.

objects.name: BidReawards
objects.description: Re-award events (~615 rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ReawardDate`) with `EffectiveFrom` / `EffectiveUntil` and `Comments` — captures when a bid's awards were partially or fully redone (e.g. winning vendor dropped out) and the validity window of the new state.

objects.name: BidRequestItemMergeActions
objects.description: Bid-request line dedup ledger (~37K rows). When two `BidRequestItems` are merged during request preparation, one row records the source and `DestinationBidRequestItemId` and a `Merged` flag. Lets the system keep the surviving line and trace where eliminated rows went.

objects.name: BidRequestItems
objects.description: Items the bid is asking about (~27.9M rows) — paired with `BidHeaderDetail` to define the buy. Vendor responses to these line items land in `BidResults`.

objects.name: BidRequestManufacturer
objects.description: Bid-request side of `BidManufacturers` (~105K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ManufacturerId`) the bid is *asking* vendors to respond on, with `SequenceNumber`, `AllowAdditionalProductLines`, and `UseOptions` flags. CASCADE FK to `BidHeaders`. Vendor responses come back via `BidMSRPResults`.

objects.name: BidRequestOptions
objects.description: Optional bid-line attributes per (manufacturer, product line) — color, capacity, etc. Each row weights one named option for use in vendor evaluation.

objects.name: BidRequestPriceRanges
objects.description: Quantity / dollar tier definitions a bid is asking vendors to price against (~1.9M rows). Tied to a `BidHeaderId` and (optionally) a manufacturer/product-line, with a `RangeBase` floor and `RangeWeight` used to compute the weighted bid score.

objects.name: BidRequestProductLines
objects.description: Bid-request side of `BidProductLines` (~176K rows). Lists the product lines under a `BidRequestManufacturer` row that vendors can respond to, with `UseOptions` and `Active` flags. Resolves which `ManufacturerProductLineId` rows the response form will offer.

objects.name: BidResultChanges
objects.description: Append-only edit log on `BidResults` (~18.2M rows). Records before/after `Active`, `UnitPrice`, `BidType`, and `Comments` whenever a vendor's bid response is modified. Pairs with `BidResultsChangeLog` which adds the user / reason context.

objects.name: BidResults
objects.description: Vendor line-item bid responses (~33.2M rows) — the prices, lead times, and notes a vendor submitted for each `BidRequestItems` line they chose to bid on.

objects.name: BidResultsChangeLog
objects.description: User-attributed reason log for `BidResults` edits (~242K rows). One row per change action with `UserId`, `SessionId`, free-text `Reason`, and the surrounding requisition / detail / item / price context. Read alongside `BidResultChanges` for the full audit picture.

objects.name: Bids
objects.description: Vendor bid response header (~147K rows). One row per (bid, vendor) submission, indicating intent to respond and submission status. Line-by-line responses are in `BidResults`.

objects.name: BidsCatalogList
objects.description: Junction `Bids` ↔ `Catalog` (~85K rows). Lists which vendor catalogs a bid response covers, with the per-catalog `DiscountRate` the vendor is offering and the source `BidImportCatalogId`.

objects.name: BidTradeCounties
objects.description: Trade × County junction (~43K rows). Defines the geographic scope of each `BidTrade` (NJ counties or other regions). Referenced by `BidImportCounties`, `TMAwards`, `TMSurveyResults`.

objects.name: BidTrades
objects.description: Per-bid trade definition (~1.6K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `TradeId`) with `Title` and full `Specifications` text — the trade-specific scope inside a bid solicitation. Parent of `BidQuestions` (CASCADE FK).

objects.name: BudgetAccounts
objects.description: District budget accounts / charge codes (~1.4M rows). Hierarchical (often fund-function-object), district-scoped. Requisition lines distribute against rows here.

objects.name: Budgets
objects.description: District budget periods (~16K rows). One row per (`DistrictId`, `Name`) covering the period between `StartDate` / `EndDate` with separate `VisibleFrom` / `VisibleUntil`, `EditFrom` / `EditUntil` windows, an `EarlyAccess` flag, and `AnnualCutoff`. Drives which budget a requisition rolls against and when buyers can see / edit against it.

objects.name: CalendarDates
objects.description: Named-calendar date set (~2.3K rows). Each `CalendarId` can hold up to four meaningful dates (`Date1`–`Date4`) with a description — used for budget cycles, bid windows, and other scheduling lookups.

objects.name: Calendars
objects.description: Master calendar definitions (~300 rows). One row per (`BudgetYear`, `ScheduleId`, `CalendarTypeId`) with `Description` and HTML / plain-text `HeaderText` / `FooterText` for printable calendar output. Date set per calendar lives in `CalendarDates`.

objects.name: Catalog
objects.description: Vendor-published catalog — a named container that groups a set of `CrossRefs` entries (~4K rows). One vendor may publish multiple catalogs (e.g., per product line or per bid award).

objects.name: CatalogText
objects.description: Per-page extracted text for each catalog (~113K rows). One row per (`CatalogId`, `PageNbr`) with the original `BaseFileName` and OCR / extracted `TextData`. Powers full-text search; tokenized form lives in `CatalogTextParts`.

objects.name: CatalogTextParts
objects.description: Tokenized catalog text for full-text search (~17M rows). One row per text fragment per `CatalogText` entry with a `BaseOffset` so the original text can be reassembled. Rebuilt during catalog imports.

objects.name: Category
objects.description: Top-level product taxonomy (~134 rows). Small, stable lookup — used for browse, reporting rollups, and price-plan scoping.

objects.name: CatList
objects.description: Denormalized catalog mailing-recipient list (~155K rows). Snapshot of (district, school, category, price plan, attention, address) used when generating physical catalog / order-book mailings. Working table — rebuilt before each mail run.

objects.name: CopyRequests
objects.description: Requisition / PO copy-job tracker (~25K rows). One row per copy operation initiated from a session — `RSId` source, `SessionId`, requested / start / end timestamps. Used to drive the async copy worker.

objects.name: Counties
objects.description: U.S. counties lookup (~78 rows). Tiny reference — `(State, Name)` per `CountyId` with a `StateId` link. Referenced by `BidTradeCounties`, trades-bid scoping, and address rollups.

objects.name: CrossRefs
objects.description: Vendor-item cross-reference (~171M rows — by far the hottest table in EDS). Maps a vendor's part number to an EDS `Items` master record with vendor-specific price, pack size, and effective dates. This is where pricing actually lives. Always filter or `TOP n` when querying — full scans are catastrophic.

columns.name: Active
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1) controlling whether this cross-ref appears in catalog browse / search results. The 1 → 0 transition is the normal soft-deactivate path; rows are rarely physically deleted.

columns.name: ItemId
columns.description: FK to `Items` — the normalized master product this vendor offering maps to. The join that connects a vendor SKU to a canonical item record.

columns.name: VendorItemCode
columns.description: The vendor's own part number / SKU for this item. The primary lookup key when processing vendor catalog files. Combined with `CatalogId` to uniquely identify a vendor's item offering.

columns.name: CatalogId
columns.description: FK to `Catalog` — the named vendor catalog this cross-ref belongs to. Use to scope queries to a specific bid catalog or active price list.

columns.name: CatalogPrice
columns.description: Vendor's catalog (list) price for this item, in dollars. The price actually charged to a buyer is computed by applying the bid/award discount on top of this value — see `GrossPrice`.

columns.name: Manufacturor
columns.description: Manufacturer name as text (note the legacy typo: `Manufacturor`, not `Manufacturer`). Use the normalized `ManufacturerId` FK instead for joins; this column is kept for historical / legacy display.

columns.name: DateDeactivated
columns.description: Set when `Active` flips to 0. NULL for currently-active cross-refs.

columns.name: GrossPrice
columns.description: Pre-discount price used when the parent vendor has `UseGrossPrices = 1`. The discounted price = `GrossPrice * (1 - discountRate)`.

columns.name: DoNotDiscount
columns.description: Boolean-as-int flag. Non-zero means the system must NOT apply bid discounts to this cross-ref — used for special-deal items priced at net.

columns.name: MatchKey
columns.description: Computed column used for fuzzy item-matching during catalog imports — typically a normalized form of vendor item code. Not for display.

columns.name: ManufacturerId
columns.description: FK to `Manufacturers` — the normalized manufacturer record. Prefer this over the text `Manufacturor` column for joins and filtering.

columns.name: HashKey
columns.description: Varbinary hash of the row's pricing and descriptor fields. Used by the catalog-import pipeline to detect unchanged rows and skip re-processing.

objects.name: CSMessages
objects.description: Per-user customer-service / banner messages (~12K rows). Free-text `CSMessage` shown to a specific `UserID` on login. Lightweight in-app notification channel, distinct from the email-driven `EmailBlast`.

objects.name: CXmlSession
objects.description: Punchout cXML session state (~67K rows). Captures the `PunchOutSetupRequest` envelope (from / to / sender domain & identity, payload ID, buyer cookie, BrowserFormPost) plus the EDS context (`RequisitionId`, `CategoryId`, `BudgetAccountId`, `Mode`) so the buyer can resume their requisition after returning from the supplier site.

objects.name: DebugMsgs
objects.description: Generic application debug log (~23.7M rows) — one row per `Msg` with `LogDate`. Purely diagnostic; safe to truncate. The `_Orig` variant is an earlier rollover.

objects.name: Detail
objects.description: Line items for both requisitions and purchase orders — ~30M rows, the largest transactional table in the procurement chain. Each row links back to its `Requisitions` (and after conversion, to its `PO`) and references either a vendor catalog item via `CrossRefs` or a free-text entry. Pricing, quantities, and account distribution all live here.

columns.name: DetailId
columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Stable across the requisition → PO conversion; line items keep the same `DetailId` once they migrate from req-only to PO-attached.

columns.name: RequisitionId
columns.description: FK to `Requisitions`. Always set — every line item belongs to a requisition. Combined with `RequisitionId`-based filtering for any per-req query.

columns.name: CatalogId
columns.description: FK to `Catalog` — the vendor catalog this item was ordered from. Used with `CrossRefId` for catalog-scoped reporting.

columns.name: ItemId
columns.description: FK to `Items` (the master product). NULL for free-text / off-catalog lines. When set, prefer joining via `CrossRefId` to get vendor-specific pricing.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Units ordered. Integer; fractional quantities are not supported on this table. Combined with `BidPrice` to compute line total.

columns.name: BidPrice
columns.description: Per-unit price at requisition time, in dollars. The frozen price the requisition is being approved against; line total = `BidPrice * Quantity`. Independent of the live `CrossRefs.CatalogPrice` (which can change).

columns.name: PricePlanId
columns.description: FK to `PricePlans` — the price plan in effect when this line was added. Scopes which awards and cross-refs were eligible.

columns.name: AwardId
columns.description: FK to `Awards` — the bid award that authorized the price and vendor on this line.

columns.name: VendorId
columns.description: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this line is being purchased from — denormalized from `CrossRefs` for performance.

columns.name: POId
columns.description: FK to `PO`. NULL while the line is still on an unconverted requisition; set when the requisition reaches final approval and converts to a purchase order. Use `WHERE POId IS NULL` to find req-only lines.

columns.name: BidHeaderId
columns.description: FK to `BidHeaders` — which bid award this price came from. Important for spend-by-bid reporting and for verifying that the captured price still reflects an active award.

columns.name: Active
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1). 0 marks a line as soft-deleted / cancelled; rows are rarely physically removed because of audit references in `DetailChangeLog`.

columns.name: CrossRefId
columns.description: FK to `CrossRefs` — the specific vendor-priced row this line was built from. Captures the vendor and price at requisition time. NULL for free-text lines.

objects.name: DetailChangeLog
objects.description: Append-only audit log of edits to `Detail` rows (~2.9M rows). Same structure as `RequisitionChangeLog` but scoped to line items.

objects.name: DetailChanges
objects.description: Quantity-change log on `Detail` lines (~26.5M rows). One row per qty edit capturing `OrigQty` / `NewQty` with `ChangeDate`, plus the surrounding `RequisitionId`, `ItemId`, `BidItemId`, `BidPrice` snapshot. Coarser-grained than `DetailChangeLog` (which is field-level across all columns) — this table tracks only quantity transitions.

objects.name: DetailMatch
objects.description: Repeat-purchase / re-order matching working set (~104K rows). For each `Detail` line it joins the `LastYearsQuantity` plus the full pricing snapshot (`BidPrice`, `CatalogPrice`, `GrossPrice`, `DiscountRate`, `AwardId`) so a buyer can be shown last-year quantities when building a new requisition. Rebuilt by batch jobs.

objects.name: DetailNotifications
objects.description: Buyer-facing notifications about line-item changes (~3M rows). When a vendor substitutes or replaces an item the system writes a row here capturing the original vs. new `ItemId`, `VendorId`, and `BidPrice` so the buyer can review.

objects.name: District
objects.description: Master record for a participating school district or other public entity (~979 rows). Top of the customer hierarchy. Budgets, approval chains, and price plans attach here. Treat as effectively static — bulk changes propagate everywhere.

objects.name: DistrictCategories
objects.description: Per-district overrides on the global `Category` taxonomy (~126K rows). Controls visibility (`Active`), surcharges (`Charge`), permission flags for addenda / incidentals / budget books / order books, RTK location, and display `Priority`. Treat as district-level configuration of the catalog browse experience.

objects.name: DistrictCharges
objects.description: District-billed charge ledger (~22K rows). Per-district recurring or one-off `Amount` charges with `ChargeTypeId`, `Frequency` / `Repeats` / `FrequencyData` for recurrence, `Invoiced` timestamp, and the `BudgetId` to bill against.

objects.name: DistrictContacts
objects.description: District contact directory (~3.8K rows). Named contacts of a given `DistrictContactTypeId` per district — full name parts, salutation, phone / fax / email, and a postal address (which can be linked to a `ShippingId`). Used for billing, RFP, and notification routing.

objects.name: DistrictContinuances
objects.description: Annual continuance / renewal sign-off per district (~14K rows). Per (`DistrictId`, `BudgetId`) record with `Status` ('P'ending → received), `SignedBy`, `Email`, `Sent` / `Received` timestamps, free-text `Comments`, and an optional `SavingsBudgetId`. Tracks the contractual rollover document each district returns each budget year.

objects.name: DistrictNotifications
objects.description: District notification routing rules (~6K rows). Per (`DistrictId`, `NotificationType`, optional `CategoryId` / `UserId`) — defines `Method`, `NotifyList`, and `OtherNotify` so the system knows where to send each event class for that district.

objects.name: DistrictPP
objects.description: District ↔ `PricePlans` junction (~9.3K rows). Lists which price plans a district has access to. FK to `PricePlans`. Combined with `VendorCategoryPP` (vendor / category visibility per plan), this is the primary control on what catalog the buyer sees.

objects.name: DistrictProposedCharges
objects.description: Proposed-but-unapplied district charges (~12K rows). Pre-application staging row capturing the proposed `Amount`, `PreviousAmount`, `ChangePercentage`, `Action`, and timing — moves into `DistrictCharges` when applied (`DateApplied` set).

objects.name: DistrictVendor
objects.description: Per-district vendor enablement (~317K rows). FK to both `District` and `Vendors`; the `Active` flag scopes a vendor's visibility to a specific district, and `VendorsAccountCode` stores the district's internal account code with that vendor (used on POs).

objects.name: DMSBidDocuments
objects.description: Bid attachments stored in DMS — one row per uploaded file per bid (~29K rows). `DocId` is the GUID into DMS storage; `DistrictVisible`, `PagesCaptured`, and `FileName` are metadata. Companion to `DMSVendorBidDocuments` which is vendor-side.

objects.name: DMSSDSDocuments
objects.description: DMS pointer for legacy MSDS documents (~602 rows). Per `MSDSId` row holding the DMS `DocId`, `PagesCaptured`, and `DocName`. Older / parallel storage to `SDSDocs` (which is the current binary store) — the two diverge by ingestion vintage.

objects.name: DMSVendorBidDocuments
objects.description: Document metadata for vendor bid attachments stored in the document-management system (~750K rows). One row per uploaded file with `DocType`, `ExpirationDate`, page count, and a `DocId` GUID pointing into DMS storage.

objects.name: DMSVendorDocuments
objects.description: Vendor-supplied compliance / qualification documents stored in DMS (~6.5K rows). Per-vendor (`VendorCode`) document with `DocType`, `ExpirationDate`, `DocumentNumber`, `PagesCaptured`, `FileName`, and a DMS `DocId` GUID. Distinct from `DMSVendorBidDocuments` (bid-attached) and `DMSBidDocuments` (bid-side).

objects.name: EmailBlast
objects.description: Saved email-blast definitions / send history (~18K rows). One row per blast — name, HTML body, recipient `SQLStmt` and `ReportWhereClause`, `EmailFrom`/`CC`/`BCC`/`Subject`, attachments, priority and read-receipt flags, and `SentDate` once dispatched.

objects.name: EmailBlastLog
objects.description: Audit of every transactional / marketing email sent from the platform (~1.5M rows). Captures sender, recipient, CC/BCC, send date, and the rendered XML payload. `Attachment` is the file name, not the content.

objects.name: FreezeItems
objects.description: Bid-window price freeze list (~15K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ItemId`, `CrossRefId`, `VendorId`) capturing the `GrossPrice` snapshot taken at freeze time so prices can't be altered after a vendor's response window closes.

objects.name: HeaderWorkItems
objects.description: Working set of items being aggregated into an OrderBook header (~492K rows). Transient — populated during OrderBook generation and emptied when the run completes.

objects.name: Headings
objects.description: Sub-category browse-tree headings under each `Category` (~306K rows). Can be district-scoped via `DistrictId`; `ExpandAll` controls default UI expansion. Drives the catalog browse hierarchy buyers see when shopping.

objects.name: ImageErrors
objects.description: Image-fetch error log (~27K rows). One row per failed image URL with the error text and `logDate`. Companion to `ImageLog` — `ImageLog` records every attempt; `ImageErrors` records only the failures with full error messages.

objects.name: ImageLog
objects.description: Image-fetch audit log (~1.8M rows). One row per HTTP fetch attempt with `statusCode`, `statusText`, `contentType`, response headers, and write outcome. Used to diagnose broken / stale image URLs sourced from vendor catalogs.

objects.name: Images
objects.description: Master image-asset record (~1.7M rows). Holds source URL, local paths (full / resized / thumbnail), perceptual hash (`pHash`, `bipHash`) for dedup, format / dimensions, and a `dateDeleted` soft-delete column. The single source of truth for product imagery referenced by catalog UI.

objects.name: ImportCatalogDetail
objects.description: Per-event log under an `ImportCatalogHeader` (~19K rows). Captures `ImportInfoType`, `ImportInfoDesc`, `ImportInfoValue`, and timestamp for each pipeline event during a catalog import run.

objects.name: ImportCatalogHeader
objects.description: Catalog-import pipeline run header (~3K rows). Symmetric to `PostCatalogHeader` but for the inbound side — `ImportDateStart` / `ImportDateComplete` per `CatalogId`. Detail rows live in `ImportCatalogDetail`.

objects.name: ImportDetail
objects.description: Raw rows captured from a generic file import (~883K rows). One row of `ImportData` per source line, scoped to an `ImportId` header. Read after parsing to inspect malformed input.

objects.name: ImportMessages
objects.description: Per-import-process message log (~5.5K rows). One row per `Message` with `MsgDate` against a `ProcessId`. Lower-level than `Batches` (header) — captures the human-readable progress / warning text emitted during an import run.

objects.name: ImportProcesses
objects.description: Import-job process run history (~754 rows). Per (`ImportId`, `ProcessDate`) — one row each time the process step ran for a given `Imports` job. `ImportMessages.ProcessId` references this row.

objects.name: Imports
objects.description: Catalog / data-import job header (~301 rows). One row per import attempt — `ImportType`, `ImportDate`, `Records`, `ErrorCount`, target `CategoryId`, `PricePlanId`, and up to six `CatalogId1`–`CatalogId6` slots being loaded simultaneously. Companion to `Batches` (which is requisition-side).

objects.name: IPQueue
objects.description: Generic in-process / import-process job queue (~5K rows). One row per job — `Queue` name, target `Email`, lifecycle timestamps (`Requested` / `Started` / `Completed`), and `Status`. The header that `IPQueueUsers` (per-user assignments) hangs off of.

objects.name: IPQueueUsers
objects.description: Per-user import-process queue assignments (~490K rows). Tracks `Requested`, `Started`, `Completed` timestamps and `Status` so background work can be parallelized and resumed.

objects.name: Items
objects.description: Master product catalog (~44M rows) — normalized, vendor-agnostic items that vendor offerings link to via `CrossRefs`. Categorized by `Category` and (where applicable) attributed to a `Manufacturers` record.

objects.name: ItemUpdates
objects.description: Per-item update log (~199K rows). Records `UpdateField` / `Action` taken on an `ItemId` with a `Reason` code. Used to audit catalog-side item edits driven by import jobs.

objects.name: Keywords
objects.description: Search / browse keywords attached to a `Category` and optional `Heading` (~25K rows). District-scoped via `DistrictId`. Drives keyword-based catalog navigation; tied into pricing rollups via `PricingAddenda.KeywordId` and `HeadingKeywordId`.

objects.name: ManufacturerProductLines
objects.description: Manufacturer product-line master (~14K rows). One row per (`ManufacturerId`, `Name`) with `Active` and `UseOptions` flags. Referenced from `BidProductLines.ManufacturerProductLineId`, `BidRequestProductLines`, `BidMSRPResultsProductLines`, and `PriceRanges` to resolve which product line a bid line covers.

objects.name: Manufacturers
objects.description: Manufacturer/brand directory (~9K rows). Note the legacy column spelling `Manufacturor` appears in some related tables — see quirks reference. Items reference a manufacturer; vendors do not.

objects.name: MSDS
objects.description: Legacy MSDS sheet master (~59K rows). One row per MSDS document with `Active`, `CurrentVersionMSDSId` for chained revisions, and `ContentCentralMSDSDocId` pointing to the document blob in ContentCentral. Detail rows in `MSDSDetail` (CASCADE FK). Superseded for new ingestion by `SafetyDataSheets` / `SDSDocs`.

objects.name: MSDSDetail
objects.description: Chemical-composition lines on a legacy MSDS sheet (~138K rows). Junction of `MSDS` to `RTK_CASFile` with `MixturePercent`. FK CASCADE on parent `MSDS`. Superseded for current ingestion by the SDS pipeline (`SafetyDataSheets` / `SDSDocs`) but still queried for historical sheets.

objects.name: MSRPExcelExport
objects.description: Staging table for exporting MSRP responses to Excel (~563 rows). All columns typed as varchar so the export can preserve raw text. Mirror of `MSRPExcelImport` for the outbound direction.

objects.name: MSRPExcelImport
objects.description: Staging table for vendor-submitted MSRP price-list Excel uploads (~76K rows). Holds parsed rows from the spreadsheet (manufacturer, product-line group, delivery option, and up to seven (Base, Weight) tiers) before promotion into `BidMSRPResults*` / `PriceRanges`.

objects.name: NextNumber
objects.description: PO / requisition / receiver sequence generator (~25K rows). One row per (`DistrictId`, `SchoolId`, `BudgetId`, `IdType`) sequence with `Prefix`, `Suffix`, `NextNumber`, `EndNumber`, formatting flags (`SuppressLZ`, `NumberLength`, `ActualNumber`), and a free-form `FFMessage`. Atomic increment here is what produces the next PO number for that scope.

objects.name: Notifications
objects.description: Per-recipient notification send log (~720 rows). One row per (`UserId`, `Email`, `EmailBlastId`) send with `DateSent`, `NotificationType`, and the rendered `EmailHTMLTable` payload. Receipts / delivery audit for blasts and other notifications.

objects.name: OrderBookDetail
objects.description: Aggregated order/spending facts used by reporting (~37.8M rows). Fed from completed `PODetailItems`. The `OrderBookDetailOld` table (~187M rows) is the prior-format archive — read but do not write.

objects.name: OrderBookDetailOld
objects.description: Legacy archive of `OrderBookDetail` (~187M rows). Read-only; all new spend rolls up into `OrderBookDetail`.

objects.name: OrderBookLog
objects.description: Print / render log for OrderBooks (~474K rows). Captures who printed which `OrderBookId` (district / school / user), how many items and pages were emitted, and the target `Device`. Operational telemetry, not a financial record.

objects.name: OrderBooks
objects.description: Master record for each printable OrderBook (~30K rows). One row per (`DistrictId`, `CategoryId`, `OrderBookYear`, `PricePlanId` / `AwardId`) — defines the catalog snapshot, markup, master-book role, and zero-page handling. Print events are logged in `OrderBookLog`; line items being assembled live in `HeaderWorkItems`.

objects.name: PendingApprovals
objects.description: Active work queue — one row per (requisition, approver) pair currently awaiting action. Rows are deleted as approvers act; historical record is preserved in `Approvals`.

objects.name: PO
objects.description: Purchase order header (~2.5M rows). Created when a requisition reaches final approval and is converted. One PO has many `PODetailItems` lines and references the originating `Requisitions` row 1:1.

columns.name: POId
columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Stable forever — referenced by `PODetailItems`, `Detail.POId`, and all downstream receiving/status tables.

columns.name: RequisitionId
columns.description: FK to `Requisitions` (1:1). Every PO traces back to exactly one requisition. Use this to navigate up to approvals, user, school, and category context.

columns.name: VendorId
columns.description: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this PO is addressed to — determined at conversion from the vendor on the winning `Detail` lines.

columns.name: PONumber
columns.description: Human-readable PO number printed on the document and sent to the vendor (e.g. `PO-00045678`). Unique within a district but not globally — use `POId` as the stable key.

columns.name: PODate
columns.description: Date the PO was formally created / converted from the approved requisition.

columns.name: DateExported
columns.description: Timestamp when the PO was exported to the vendor or to a finance system. NULL if not yet exported. `ExportedToVendor` is the vendor-facing equivalent.

columns.name: Amount
columns.description: Total PO value in dollars (items + shipping), as of the last calculation. Frozen at PO issuance but can be updated if addenda are applied.

columns.name: AwardId
columns.description: FK to `Awards` — the specific bid award that authorized pricing on this PO.

columns.name: DiscountRate
columns.description: The bid discount rate applied to this PO, stored as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.12 = 12%). Used with `TotalGross` to derive `DiscountAmount`.

columns.name: ExportedToVendor
columns.description: Timestamp when the PO was transmitted to the vendor (ePO / email / EDI). NULL means not yet sent. Distinct from `DateExported` which tracks finance-system export.

columns.name: Cancelled
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1). 1 means the PO was voided after issuance. Cancelled POs are retained for audit; exclude with `WHERE Cancelled = 0` for active-PO queries.

columns.name: POStatusID
columns.description: FK to `POStatus` — the PO lifecycle state (open, partial, received, closed, voided). The authoritative status field; prefer this over inferring status from date columns.

columns.name: isActualNumber
columns.description: Tinyint flag. 1 = the `PONumber` is the district's own externally assigned number; 0 = it was system-generated. Relevant for districts that manage PO numbering in their own finance system.

columns.name: ePOSuppressed
columns.description: Tinyint flag. 1 = electronic PO transmission was suppressed for this PO (e.g. vendor requested paper only). Used by the ePO dispatch job to skip transmission.

objects.name: PODetailItems
objects.description: PO line-item detail (~24.5M rows). Snapshot of item, quantity, unit price, and account split at the moment of PO issuance. Independent from `Detail` — Detail can change after PO issuance, PODetailItems is the immutable contractual record.

columns.name: PODetailItemId
columns.description: Surrogate primary key for the immutable PO line snapshot. Distinct from `DetailId` — one `Detail` row produces exactly one `PODetailItems` row at conversion.

columns.name: POId
columns.description: FK to `PO`. Always set — every PO line item belongs to a purchase order.

columns.name: DetailId
columns.description: Back-link to the originating `Detail` row. Lets you trace from a PO line back to the requisition history.

columns.name: ItemId
columns.description: FK to `Items`. Frozen at PO issuance — does NOT update if the master `Items` row changes later.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Units ordered, locked in at PO issuance. For receiving variance, compare against the receiving-side tables, not against `Detail.Quantity`.

columns.name: BidPrice
columns.description: Per-unit price locked in at PO issuance, in dollars. Contractual — does not change even if the source bid is later re-awarded or `Detail.BidPrice` is edited.

columns.name: DiscountRate
columns.description: Bid discount rate frozen at PO issuance as a decimal fraction. `BidPrice` is already the discounted value; this column retains the rate for audit / recalculation.

columns.name: AwardId
columns.description: FK to `Awards` — the bid award that authorized vendor and price for this line, frozen at PO issuance.

columns.name: VendorId
columns.description: FK to `Vendors`. The vendor this PO line ships from — frozen at PO issuance.

objects.name: POLayoutDetail
objects.description: Per-PO-layout field placement (~6.9K rows). For each `POLayoutId`, defines the position, size, wrap, literal text, optional embedded image, and `PrintWhen` rule for each `POLayoutFieldId`. Drives the print rendering of POs in the chosen template.

objects.name: POLayoutFields
objects.description: PO-layout field catalog (~56 rows). Defines each field that can be placed on a PO (`POLayoutField` name, type, `POLayoutSource` SQL fragment to resolve the value, and `DetailField` flag for line-item-vs-header). Referenced by `POLayoutDetail.POLayoutFieldId`.

objects.name: POLayouts
objects.description: PO print layout master (~636 rows). Defines named templates with `FormLength` / `FormWidth`, `ContinuousFeed` flag, copy count, and `FormType`. Field placement under each layout lives in `POLayoutDetail`.

objects.name: POPageSummary
objects.description: Per-PO line / page count summary (~73K rows). Aggregate of how many lines and printed pages a `POId` produces, scoped by district / category. Used by the print pipeline to size jobs.

objects.name: POPrintTaggedPOFile
objects.description: Staging table for the tagged-PO print pipeline (~121K rows). Holds the (district, PO, account, budget, bid-source) fields for each PO line being rendered into the printable, tagged PO file format. Working set — populated and consumed by print jobs.

objects.name: POQueue
objects.description: Outbound PO transmission queue header (~27K rows). One row per (`UserId`, `VendorId`, `SessionId`) send request with `SendAddress`, scheduling fields, and free-text `OrderComments`. Per-PO send attempts are logged in `POQueueItems`.

objects.name: POQueueItems
objects.description: Outbound PO transmission queue (~401K rows). One row per PO send attempt, with `SendStarted`, `SendEnded`, `SendStatus` and a `PayloadId` referencing the rendered cXML / email body.

objects.name: POStatus
objects.description: Lookup table of PO lifecycle states (open, partial, received, closed, voided, etc.) joined to `PO` via status code.

objects.name: PostCatalogDetail
objects.description: Post-catalog-import event log (~43K rows). One row per post-processing event under a `PostCatalogHeader`, capturing event type, description, value, and timestamp. Operational, not analytical.

objects.name: PostCatalogHeader
objects.description: Catalog-post pipeline run header (~3.6K rows). One row per (`CatalogId`, post run) with `PostDateStart` / `PostDateComplete`. Per-event detail in `PostCatalogDetail`.

objects.name: POTempDetails
objects.description: PO-creation working table (~4K rows). Holds in-flight PO line context (PO number parts, `RequisitionID`, `VendorID`, `BidHeaderID`) under a `POTempID` while a PO is being assembled — populated and consumed during PO conversion.

objects.name: PPCatalogs
objects.description: Junction `PricePlans` × `Category` × `Catalog` (~1.7K rows). Determines which catalogs are visible under a price plan for a category, with the `DiscountRate` and the linking `AwardId`. The price-plan side of catalog visibility (vs `BidsCatalogList` / `AwardsCatalogList` which are bid-side).

objects.name: PPCategory
objects.description: Junction `PricePlans` × `Category` (~1.5K rows) with `AllowAddenda` flag. Controls whether buyers on a given price plan can add catalog addenda for that category.

objects.name: PricePlans
objects.description: Named price-plan definitions (~585 rows) — controls which categories/vendors are visible to which districts at what pricing tier. Small but pivotal: changes here change what buyers see.

objects.name: PriceRanges
objects.description: Tiered MSRP / list-price brackets per (`CategoryId`, `ManufacturerId`, `ManufacturerProductLineId`) (~120K rows). `RangeBase` and `RangeWeight` parameterize price-based scoring used during bid evaluation and MSRP normalization.

objects.name: PricingAddenda
objects.description: Denormalized item-pricing snapshot used to render pricing addenda (~210K rows). Flattens `CrossRefs` + `Catalog` + `Heading` + `Keyword` + `Vendor` + `District` + `Award` into a wide row including catalog / list / last-bid prices, full description, and indexed text fields. Rebuilt by addendum jobs.

objects.name: PricingConsolidatedOrderCounts
objects.description: Demand-history counts feeding the consolidated-pricing analytics pipeline (~401K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `ItemId`) with `OrderCount` — used to weight bid evaluation by realized buying patterns.

objects.name: PricingUpdate
objects.description: Per-bid incremental-recompute marker (~60K rows). One row per `BidHeaderId` with `LastUpdated` — used to drive incremental updates to downstream pricing tables (`PricingAddenda`, `CrossRefs`) when only a subset of bids has changed.

objects.name: ProductVerificationResults
objects.description: Automated product-verification results (~207K rows). One row per (`EntryId`, `QueryType`) — likely an LLM / rules-engine check — with `VerificationResult`, full `DataChecked` payload, and `Reasoning` text. Unique on (EntryId, QueryType).

objects.name: ReportSession
objects.description: User-facing report executions (~5.4M rows) — what reports were run, by whom, with which parameters.

objects.name: ReportSessionLinks
objects.description: Per-session output links (~52.7M rows) — joins a report session to the rows it generated, used to support drill-throughs and saved exports.

objects.name: RequisitionChangeLog
objects.description: Append-only audit log of edits to requisition headers and lines (~1.9M rows). Captures field-level before/after values with user and timestamp. Used for the requisition history view.

objects.name: RequisitionNoteEmails
objects.description: Per-note email-recipient list (~17K rows). Junction `RequisitionNotes` × `Users` — one row per user that should be emailed when a note is added.

objects.name: RequisitionNotes
objects.description: Free-text notes attached to a requisition (~25K rows). One row per note with `RequisitionID`, `Note` body, `CreateDate`, `CreatedByUserID`. Recipients of email notifications about each note are tracked in `RequisitionNoteEmails`.

objects.name: Requisitions
objects.description: Header record for every purchase request created in EDS. One row per requisition; line items live in `Detail`. Drives the approval workflow that ultimately produces a PO. Belongs to a District and originating User.

columns.name: RequisitionId
columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Stable forever — referenced by `Detail`, `Approvals`, `PendingApprovals`, `PO`, and all audit/change-log tables.

columns.name: Active
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1). 0 marks a soft-deleted or voided requisition. Nearly all queries should filter `Active = 1` unless doing audit or recovery work.

columns.name: RequisitionNumber
columns.description: Human-readable requisition number displayed in the UI and on printed forms (e.g. `REQ-00012345`). Not guaranteed unique across all time — use `RequisitionId` as the stable key.

columns.name: SchoolId
columns.description: FK to `School` — the school / department this requisition ships to.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: FK to `Users` — the staff member who created the requisition.

columns.name: CategoryId
columns.description: FK to `Category` — the product category this requisition is scoped to. Drives which bid awards and price plans are available.

columns.name: AccountCode
columns.description: Budget account code string as entered by the user. Format varies by district (see `AccountingFormats`). Stored denormalized here for reporting convenience.

columns.name: DateEntered
columns.description: Timestamp when the requisition was first saved by the user. Immutable after creation.

columns.name: TotalItemsCost
columns.description: Sum of `BidPrice * Quantity` across all active `Detail` lines, in dollars. Does not include shipping or addenda.

columns.name: TotalRequisitionCost
columns.description: Denormalized total (items + shipping + addenda), in dollars. Kept in sync by the application; use for display and reporting. For exact audit totals, sum from `Detail` + `AddendaTotal`.

columns.name: ApprovalRequired
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1). 0 means no approval chain applies (auto-approved). 1 means the requisition must traverse the district's approval chain before converting.

columns.name: ApprovalLevel
columns.description: Current approval level the requisition is at — increments each time an approver acts. Combined with `ApprovalRequired` to determine whether further approvals are needed.

columns.name: StatusId
columns.description: FK to a status lookup. Controls the lifecycle state (draft, pending approval, approved, converted to PO, voided, etc.). Use `StatusId` joins rather than inferring state from other columns.

columns.name: OrderDate
columns.description: Timestamp when the requisition was converted / submitted for ordering. NULL while still in draft or approval.

columns.name: DateExported
columns.description: Timestamp when the requisition data was last exported to an external system (e.g. finance integration). NULL if never exported.

columns.name: SourceId
columns.description: Integer code indicating how the requisition was created: 1 = manual UI entry, 2 = OrderBook import, 3 = batch upload, etc. Useful for diagnosing unusual data patterns.

columns.name: BidHeaderId
columns.description: FK to `BidHeaders` — the active bid award in effect when the requisition was placed. Determines vendor and pricing eligibility.

columns.name: POCount
columns.description: Denormalized count of POs generated from this requisition. Normally 1 (one PO per vendor); can be >1 if lines were split across vendors.

objects.name: ResetPasswordTracking
objects.description: Password-reset email audit (~125K rows). One row per reset request with the issued `ResetPasswordCode`, target email, district / school context, and action / error payload. Indexed on `ResetPasswordCode` for verification.

objects.name: RTK_CASFile
objects.description: Right-To-Know CAS-number reference file (~7.9K rows). Master chemical record per `CASRegNo` with chemical / DOT / substance numbers, trade-secret designation, and dozens of NJ-RTK hazard flags (`SpecialHealthHazard`, `Carcinogen`, `Mutagen`, `Teratogen`, `Corrosive`, flammability / reactivity tiers, etc.). Joined by `MSDSDetail` and `RTK_MSDSDetail` to identify constituents.

objects.name: RTK_FactSheets
objects.description: NJ Right-To-Know Hazardous Substance Fact Sheets (~2.5K rows). Per-substance reference — `CommonName`, `ChemicalName`, `CASNumber`, `DOTNumber`, `HazardCodes`. Soft-deleted via `Deleted` timestamp.

objects.name: RTK_Inventories
objects.description: Annual chemical-inventory record per RTK site (~658 rows). One row per (`RTK_SiteId`, `RTK_InventoryYear`) with `RTK_InventoryDate`, `RTK_InventoryBy` submitter, and free-text `RTK_InventoryNotes`. Drives the date-stamped 'inventory taken' attestation on the RTK report.

objects.name: RTK_Items
objects.description: Right-To-Know item catalog (~65K rows). Chemical-inventory items linked to `Items.ItemId` with NJ-RTK-specific attributes (CAS percent, container/UOM codes, legacy COMET code, manufacturer). Joined with `RTK_MSDSDetail` for chemical composition and `RTK_ReportItems` for survey output.

objects.name: RTK_LegacyDistrictCodesMap
objects.description: Legacy district-code translation table (~78 rows). Maps the historical (`Legacy_DistrictCode`, `SQL_DistrictCode`) two-character codes onto the modern surrogate `DistrictId`. Read-mostly; lets historical RTK / batch files reference districts by their old codes.

objects.name: RTK_LegacySchoolFile
objects.description: Legacy NJ-RTK school-file mapping (~6.8K rows). Maps the old (`LegacyDistrictCode`, `LegacySchoolCode`, `NJEIN`) identifiers + `ExposedEmployees` count to current `DistrictId` / `RTK_SitesId`. Read-mostly; preserved so historical RTK exports can be reproduced.

objects.name: RTK_MSDSDetail
objects.description: Right-To-Know variant of `MSDSDetail` keyed to `RTK_Items` instead of `MSDS` (~152K rows). Feeds the NJ RTK reporting flow alongside `RTK_ReportItems` and `RTK_CASFile`.

objects.name: RTK_ReportItems
objects.description: New Jersey Right-To-Know chemical-reporting line items (~1M rows). Joins district + site + category + item + quantity, paired with `RTK_Sites` (locations) and `RTK_Items` (chemical detail). Feeds the annual NJ RTK survey.

objects.name: RTK_Sites
objects.description: NJ Right-To-Know facility / site master (~823 rows). Per (`DistrictId`, `NJEIN`) site with `FacilityName`, mailing address, facility-location lines, `CoMunCode`, `ChemicalInventoryStatus`, exposed-employees count, and emergency-contact info. Linked from `ShipLocations.RTK_SitesId` and `RTK_LegacySchoolFile.RTK_SitesId`. Reporting target for the annual NJ RTK survey.

objects.name: SafetyDataSheets
objects.description: Master URL list of vendor SDS documents (~158K rows). Each row is a unique `SDSURL` with created / updated / deleted timestamps. Linked physical document blobs live in `SDSDocs`.

objects.name: SaxDups
objects.description: Bid-import dedup helper (~31K rows). Per (`BidHeaderId`, `PackedCode`) tracks which packed item codes have been seen so the SAX-style streaming bid parser can skip duplicates.

objects.name: ScanEvents
objects.description: Document-scan event log (~396K rows). One row per file processed by a `ScanJobId` with `SourceFile`, `IndexData` payload, and `EventStatus`. Operational pipeline telemetry.

objects.name: School
objects.description: Schools/buildings beneath a district (~6.6K rows). Used for ship-to address and reporting rollups; not a security boundary.

objects.name: SDS_Rpt_Bridge
objects.description: Working bridge for SDS reports (~100 rows). Per (`SessionId`, `ItemId`) → `SDSDoc` mapping populated mid-run when generating an SDS-by-requisition report so the report can join consistent results without re-running the SDS resolver.

objects.name: SDSDocs
objects.description: Stored SDS document blobs (~161K rows). One PDF per row keyed to `ItemId` (and optionally `CrossRefId` / legacy `MSDSId`), with `OrigURL`, `Checksum` for dedup, and a varbinary(max) `Document`. The current SDS storage path; legacy MSDS data lives in `MSDS` / `MSDSDetail`.

objects.name: SDSResults
objects.description: SDS URL crawl / validation results (~117K rows). One row per `SafetyDataSheet` with cache-, source-, document-, and Elastic-text validity flags plus per-channel error text. Used to identify broken or unindexed SDS records.

objects.name: SDSSyncStatus
objects.description: SDS-to-search-index sync status per `SafetyDataSheet` (~26K rows). Tracks `SyncedItems` / `SyncedRequisitions` against totals, separate item / requisition statuses, and start / end timestamps. Drives the SDS Elasticsearch backfill.

objects.name: SearchSets
objects.description: Saved search-filter criteria per session (~44K rows). One row per (`SessionId`, `CategoryId`, `CatalogId`) range describing the buyer's catalog-browse filter (`SearchBy`, `SearchStart`, `SearchEnd`). Transient session state.

objects.name: SecurityRoleUsers
objects.description: User-to-security-role junction (~365K rows). Drives application-level permission checks — every effective role a user holds is one row here.

objects.name: SessionTable
objects.description: Active and recent user-session state (~12.8M rows). Holds the user's current district, school, requisition, PO, budget, mode, and screen state. Hot during business hours; queried heavily on every page load.

objects.name: ShipLocations
objects.description: District ship-to address master (~6.9K rows). One row per delivery location (`DistrictId` scoped) with full address, contact, and `LocationCode`. `RTK_SitesId` ties the location to its NJ Right-To-Know site. Selected on POs / requisitions to set the delivery destination.

objects.name: ShippingCosts
objects.description: Per-line shipping cost lookup (~1.1K rows). One row per (`DetailId`, `RequisitionId`) with `Quantity`, `Cost`, `UpdatedBy`, and an optional link to the originating `ShippingRequestId`. Surfaced on POs that need explicit shipping line items.

objects.name: ShippingRequests
objects.description: Shipping-quote requests sent to vendors (~728 rows). One row per (`RequisitionId`, `VendorId`) ask, with `EmailAddresses`, `Comments`, `RequestSent` / `RequestCompleted` timestamps, `RequestStatus`, `loadingDock` flag, and a `ShippingRequestUniqueId` GUID for vendor-side reply linking. Cost replies populate `ShippingCosts`.

objects.name: ShippingVendor
objects.description: Vendor-specific shipping methods (~39K rows). Junction `Vendors` × `Shipping` with the vendor's own `ShippingCode` and `Active` flag. Drives the shipping-method options shown when a buyer picks delivery for a vendor's PO.

objects.name: SSOLoginTracking
objects.description: SSO login event audit (~188K rows). One row per attempted SSO `Action` per (`SSOProvider`, `Email`) with `ErrorMsg` / `Description` payloads. Used to debug SAML / OAuth login failures.

objects.name: SulphiteDetail
objects.description: Working table for Sulphite (Industries) bid item resolution (~6.3K rows). Maps `Detail.DetailId` → resolved `ItemId` via `vendorItemCode` / `ItemCode`. Vendor-specific helper used to align an established Sulphite-supplied item code to the master `Items` row during requisition processing.

objects.name: Suppression
objects.description: Email / contact suppression list (~6K rows). Per `Email` / `Phone` / `Locator` row with `SuppressionType`, `Reason`, and `Handled` flag. Filters outgoing communications across the platform.

objects.name: TaskEvent
objects.description: Bid-cycle task event log (~122K rows). One row per event against a `ProjectTaskId` with date, scoping district / category / user, and a free-text `ValueField`. Pairs with `TaskSchedule` — `TaskSchedule` holds the planned dates, `TaskEvent` records what actually happened.

objects.name: TaskSchedule
objects.description: Bid-cycle / pricing-cycle work schedule (~1.5M rows). Tracks original, projected, and actual start/end dates for each task in a project, scoped by district, category, and price plan.

objects.name: TM_UOM
objects.description: Trades-bid UoM lookup (~77 rows). Description-only reference (e.g. 'Hour', 'Each', 'Square Foot') used by the trades / T&M bid forms. Distinct from the catalog `Units` table.

objects.name: TMAwards
objects.description: Trades-bid awards (~94K rows). One row per (`BidHeaderId`, `BidTradeCountyId`, `VendorId`) — the awards layer for the trades / services bid track (mirrors `Awards` for commodity bids). `AwardAmount` and `AwardType` recorded.

objects.name: TMSurvey
objects.description: Trades-vendor survey header (~862 rows). One row per district survey submission with `Submitter`, `Title`, `Email`, `Started` / `Finished` timestamps, and `CountyId`. Per-vendor scores live in `TMSurveyResults`; new-vendor / new-trade write-ins live in `TMSurveyNewVendors` / `TMSurveyNewTrades`.

objects.name: TMSurveyNewTrades
objects.description: Free-text 'new trade to consider' entries on a `TMSurvey` (~89 rows). Captures suggested trade name and description from districts requesting new trade categories.

objects.name: TMSurveyNewVendors
objects.description: Free-text 'new vendor to consider' entries on a `TMSurvey` (~202 rows). Captures vendor name, address, and contact info from districts suggesting vendors not yet in the trades pool.

objects.name: TMSurveyResults
objects.description: Trades-vendor survey responses (~98K rows). Per (`TMSurveyId`, `TMVendorId`, `BidTradeCountyId`) `Rating` and free-text `Comments` from district survey of trades vendors. Feeds vendor-performance scoring on the trades track.

objects.name: TMVendors
objects.description: Per-year trades vendor list (~16K rows). One row per (`TMYear`, `TradeId`, `CountyId`, `VendorId`) with denormalized `VendorName` and `Sequence`. Defines who is eligible to bid on a given trade in a given county for a given year.

objects.name: TopUOM
objects.description: Per-`Category` default UoM ranking (~4.6K rows). Maps `CategoryId` → `UnitId`; UI uses this to pre-select the most likely unit when a buyer adds an item from a category.

objects.name: Trades
objects.description: Trades hierarchy (~107 rows). Self-referencing tree (`ParentId`) of trade categories used for the trades-bid track, with `Description`, `Comments`, `PackageNumber`, and `pwRequired` (prevailing wage). Parent of `BidTrades` (per-bid trade rows) and `TM_UOM` etc.

objects.name: TransactionLog_HISTORY
objects.description: Long-tail historical event log (~124M rows). Cold storage — query with date filters and expect slow reads. Rarely needed for operational work; kept for compliance.

objects.name: TransactionLogCF
objects.description: Outbound HTTP request/response log for integration calls (~3.5M rows). Captures `URL`, `Method`, `Headers`, `Content`, request-start/end timestamps, target server, and session. Used to debug cXML / vendor-API integrations. Rolls over into `TransactionLogCF_Arc`.

objects.name: TransactionLogCF_Arc
objects.description: Archived rollover of `TransactionLogCF` (~31.6M rows). Same shape; cold storage for older integration request logs.

objects.name: TransmitLog
objects.description: Generic outbound HTTP transmit log (~156K rows). Captures `RequestURL`, `RequestParams`, and `RequestData` per request. Lighter-weight than `TransactionLogCF` (no response capture); used for fire-and-forget integration calls.

objects.name: Units
objects.description: Unit-of-measure lookup (~11K rows). Tiny reference; `Code` is the human-readable UoM (EA, CS, BX, …) referenced by `Detail.UnitId`, `PricingAddenda.UnitId`, and elsewhere.

objects.name: UNSPSCs
objects.description: UNSPSC commodity-code reference (~50K rows). Industry-standard product taxonomy used to tag items for analytics and external reporting. Read-mostly lookup.

objects.name: UserAccounts
objects.description: Per-user budget account permissions (~3.4M rows). Joins users to the `BudgetAccounts` they're allowed to charge against. Drives the account dropdown shown when building a requisition.

objects.name: UserAdminLog
objects.description: User-administration action log (~6.5K rows). One row per admin operation — `submituserid` acting on `targetuserid`, the `action` string, full `commitString` payload, and `actionDate`. Audits user-create / role-change / disable events.

objects.name: UserImports
objects.description: User-import staging table (~328 rows). Excel-derived columns with literal spaces in their names (`User #`, `Approver User #`, `Approval Level (Teacher/Principal/BA)`, `Account Code`, `Amount`). Working set for batch creation of district users; promoted into `Users`, `UserAccounts`, and approval trees.

objects.name: Users
objects.description: Master user directory (~345K rows) — every person with login or named-recipient status across all districts. `Active` flag controls login eligibility; deletion is rare (audit references).

objects.name: UserTrees
objects.description: Per-user approval-chain definition (~57K rows). For each (`DistrictId`, `UserId`) it lists the approvers, their `Level` and `ApprovalLevel`, and a `SortKey` that controls evaluation order. Drives which approvers populate `PendingApprovals` when a requisition is submitted.

objects.name: VendorCategory
objects.description: Vendor-by-category directory (~6.9K rows). Lighter-weight than `VendorCategoryPP` — one row per (`VendorId`, `CategoryId`) with the denormalized `VendorName` and a marketing `WebLink`. Used in directory / search displays where the price-plan dimension isn't needed.

objects.name: VendorCategoryPP
objects.description: Per-(vendor, category, district, price plan) visibility row (~18K rows). Determines whether a vendor's items in a given category appear to a district under a specific price plan. Combined with `DistrictPP` and `DistrictCategories` to compute catalog visibility.

objects.name: VendorContacts
objects.description: Named contacts (sales reps, AP contacts, etc.) attached to a vendor. Used for PO routing, bid notifications, and dispute correspondence.

objects.name: VendorOrders
objects.description: Per-(vendor, PO) integration state record (~5.8K rows). Holds vendor-side response payloads (`VendorData` JSON, `VendorStatus`) and `LastUpdated` for any vendor that returns acknowledgement / shipment data via integration.

objects.name: VendorQuery
objects.description: Vendor-query (clarification) header (~12K rows). One row per email/fax sent to a vendor about a bid response — `BidHeaderId`, `VendorId`, `BidImportId`, sent / receipt-confirmed timestamps, full `MessageContent`, and contact addresses. Per-line questions are in `VendorQueryDetail`; status transitions are in `VendorQueryStatus`.

objects.name: VendorQueryDetail
objects.description: Per-line vendor questions raised during bid evaluation / import (~135K rows). One row per query about a `BidResultsId` line with the `ItemQuery` text, send / resolved timestamps, and a `CommonVendorQueryId` to group related questions. Companion to `VendorQueryStatus`.

objects.name: VendorQueryMSRP
objects.description: MSRP variant of `VendorQuery` (~140 rows). Clarification-message header scoped to MSRP-bid responses. Same structure as `VendorQuery`.

objects.name: VendorQueryStatus
objects.description: Status timeline for a `VendorQuery` (~31K rows). Per-status-transition row with `StatusDate` and `FollowUpDate`. Pairs with `VendorQuery` (the message) and `VendorQueryDetail` (the per-line questions).

objects.name: VendorQueryTandM
objects.description: T&M (Trades / Time-and-Materials) variant of `VendorQuery` (~1.9K rows). Same shape as `VendorQuery` but scoped to the trades-bid track. Header for clarification messages sent to trades vendors about their bid response.

objects.name: VendorQueryTandMDetail
objects.description: Per-line T&M vendor queries (~1.2K rows). Mirrors `VendorQueryDetail` for the trades track, with extra `TandMQueryType`, `TandMQueryCounties`, and `ResolvedFlag`.

objects.name: VendorQueryTandMStatus
objects.description: Status timeline for a `VendorQueryTandM` (~1.9K rows). Per-transition row with `StatusDate` / `FollowUpDate`. CASCADE FK to `VendorQueryTandM`.

objects.name: Vendors
objects.description: Master vendor record — supplier directory for the whole platform (~19K rows). One row per vendor company. The `Active` column (tinyint) gates whether a vendor's catalogs and bid responses are visible to buyers; mutating it has system-wide effect.

columns.name: Active
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1) controlling whether the vendor is visible across the platform. Setting to 0 hides the vendor's catalogs and bid responses everywhere — system-wide effect, not a soft delete.

columns.name: Code
columns.description: Short alphanumeric vendor code (≤16 chars) used as a human-friendly identifier on POs and reports. Distinct from `VendorId` (the surrogate key).

columns.name: UseGrossPrices
columns.description: Tinyint flag (0/1). If 1, this vendor's pricing is interpreted as gross (list) prices that must be discounted against bid terms. If 0, prices are net.

columns.name: DistrictId
columns.description: When non-null, marks this vendor as district-specific (only visible to that district). When null, the vendor is platform-wide.

objects.name: VendorSessions
objects.description: Vendor-portal session tracking (~11K rows). One row per vendor login session — `VendorId`, `UserName`, `jSession` token, `StartTime` / `EndTime`, `IPAddress`, and `VPORegistrationId`. Distinct from `Users` (district-side) sessions.

objects.name: VendorUploads
objects.description: Log of every vendor catalog or pricing file submitted (~1.5M rows). Tracks file name, vendor, upload type, status, and the eventual import result. Direct writes to `CrossRefs` should always trace back to a row here.

objects.name: YearlyTotals
objects.description: Per-(`BudgetId`, district) annual savings rollup (~11K rows). Wide reporting row totalling bid / catalog / state-contract costs and savings, included vs. excluded buckets, and overall percent savings / discount. Output of the annual savings calculation; consumed by reporting.
